title: LEMUR: Latent Entropy-aware Multimodal Unlearning via Visual-anchored Reasoning Redirection
abstract: arXiv:2608.11691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training equips multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) with exploratory chains of thought (CoT), substantially improving visual reasoning. However, we find that this capability introduces a distinct privacy vulnerability: even when a sensitive fact is successfully unlearned from the final answer, the model may still reproduce it in its reasoning trace. This leakage is substantially more pronounced in natively RL-trained MLRMs than in their non -reasoning base models, revealing a privacy risk that existing unlearning methods are not designed to address. We show that RL-induced exploration leaves sensitive content with a distinctive token-level entropy signature that is largely absent from base models. Based on this observation, we propose LEMUR, a fully training-free, inference-time unlearning framework for natively RL-trained multimodal models. translated_title: LEMUR：基于视觉锚定推理重定向的潜在熵感知多模态遗忘
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11691v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：强化学习（RL）后训练使多模态大型推理模型（MLRMs）具备探索性思维链（CoT），显著提升了视觉推理能力。然而，我们发现这种能力引入了一个独特的隐私漏洞：即使一个敏感事实已成功从最终答案中遗忘，模型仍可能在推理过程中重现它。这种泄漏在原生RL训练的MLRMs中比非推理基础模型更为显著，揭示了现有遗忘方法未设计解决的一种隐私风险。我们表明，RL诱导的探索使敏感内容具有独特的标记级熵特征，而这种特征在基础模型中基本不存在。基于这一观察，我们提出了LEMUR，一种完全无需训练、推理时执行的遗忘框架，专为原生RL训练的多模态模型设计。LEMUR利用熵动态作为控制信号来识别并重定向推理路径，从而有效抑制敏感信息的泄漏。
tldr: 本文提出LEMUR，一种无需训练的推理时遗忘框架，通过熵动态检测并重定向推理路径，解决了RL训练多模态模型中敏感信息在思维链中泄漏的隐私问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LEMUR, a training-free inference-time unlearning framework that uses entropy dynamics to detect and redirect reasoning paths, addressing the privacy leakage of sensitive information in the chain-of-thought of RL-trained multimodal models.
